description: Extract an archive on a specific instance (by id or exact name). Supports .tar.zstd, .tar.zst, .tar.gz, .tar.xz, .mcworld, .mcpack, .mcaddon, .tzst, .txz, .zst, .zip, .tar, .rar, .gz, .7z (Minecraft .mcworld/.mcpack/.mcaddon are zips). Extracting writes new files into the destination folder and never deletes the archive itself. Requires `confirm: true`; show the user the archive and where it lands first.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be extracted, naming the archive and the destination folder and getting their approval.

destination.description: Folder to extract into, from the instance root. Defaults to the archive's own folder. Existing files with the same names are overwritten.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

path.description: Path to the archive, from the instance root, e.g. "/world-backup.zip".

name: extract_archive
title: Extract Archive
